non_claims: Only the N-methoxy group is claimed; further ring substitution is assigned by the precursor composition hypothesis.
Glucose versus another hexose and oxime geometry are not resolved.

notes: Radical loss of CH3O from [M-H]- is reported for neoglucobrassicin in five papers (two with standards) and is absent for 4-methoxyglucobrassicin in three; the enumerated list holds neoglucobrassicin only.

competitors.note: 4-Methoxyglucobrassicin has the same formula and lacks the CH3O radical loss (Hooshmand 2021 Table 4; Glauser 2012 Fig. 5; Cataldi 2007 Table 4).

priors.note: In negative-mode direct infusion of the standards only the deprotonated glucosinolate ions were seen, with no adduct or degradation ions.
The deprotonated sulfate [M-H]- is the predominant glucosinolate ion in negative ESI.
